channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Micron beats on earnings and issues strong guidance as data center revenue jumps 11-fold
item.description: Micron is up over 500% in the past year as the company benefits from soaring AI demand.

item.title: Sen. Hawley: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman declined to testify at rogue AI hearing
item.description: A Senate subcommittee on Wednesday is examining rogue AI, after a series of AI cyberattacks and increasing warnings about the risks of the technology.

item.title: Crude oil exports through the Strait of Hormuz hit prewar levels, but fuel shipments remain constrained
item.description: It is unclear how long the recovery can be sustained given that it relies on the U.S. military protecting tankers in the Persian Gulf.

item.title: Grindr expands beyond dating with $250 million telehealth acquisition of PurposeMed
item.description: Grindr is buying PrEP provider Freddie for $250 million, expanding into healthcare and seeking to make HIV prevention more accessible to its users.

item.title: David Ellison names Ynon Kreiz co-CEO of Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery
item.description: Paramount CEO David Ellison announced outgoing Mattel chief Ynon Kreiz will serve as the co-CEO of the anticipated combination of Paramount and WBD.

item.title: Broken market: 75% of S&P 500 stocks had a lousy September
item.description: The S&P 500 appears strong at the index level, but most of its individual stocks had a poor month.

item.title: Fed watchdog finds renovation failures, but no grounds for criminal referral
item.description: The long-awaited report by the Fed's inspector general said it found no reasonable grounds to believe federal criminal law had been violated.

item.title: Elon Musk, Palmer Luckey and Newt Gingrich to help Pentagon with warfare initiative, Hegseth says
item.description: Pete Hegseth, in remarks about the state of the military, announced a project led by two GOP-supporting tech executives to examine military capabilities.

item.title: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick reports more than $250 million in income last year
item.description: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick unwound his ties to Cantor Fitzgerald as the billionaire financier joined the Trump administration.

item.title: Stellantis CEO reconfirms 2026 guidance, says turnaround plan continues as automaker's shares hit new low
item.description: Stellantis CEO Antonio Filosa on Wednesday reconfirmed the company's 2026 guidance and its plans to be cash flow positive by 2027.

item.title: Treasury launches student loan support center as new data show 9.3 million borrowers in default
item.description: The Trump administration announced on Wednesday that it was launching a "Default Loans Support Center" for student loan borrowers who've fallen behind.

item.title: Trump administration starts sending $500 Obamacare refund checks — who stands to benefit
item.description: The refunds come after millions of people lost premium subsidies for their health insurance, and right before the midterm elections.

item.title: Passengers overcame pilot who tried to crash Flydubai flight, Israel says
item.description: The co-pilot of a Flydubai plane has been arrested after he tried to crash a flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv before being subdued by passengers.

item.title: Two trades that just happened in 'Magnificent Seven' stocks point to big gains ahead
item.description: Options volume was more than 50% above the 30-day average in both names Wednesday.

item.title: Senators clinch construction permitting deal before election jet-set
item.description: A legislative deal to ease construction permitting sets up potential action in Congress when lawmakers return after the November election.

item.title: This driverless trucking stock could be a double or more. Here’s why I’m buying despite the risks
item.description: Aurora Innovation is scaling its driverless trucking business rapidly, while a shift to an asset-light model could accelerate growth.

item.title: FTC is investigating OpenAI, Anthropic and other AI companies over product risks
item.description: The probe adds to the mounting scrutiny that OpenAI and Anthropic have been facing over their safety practices following the Hugging Face hack.

item.title: Senate Democrats sink 'toothless' stock trading ban, data center bill in last act before election recess
item.description: Two separate proposals to ban member stock trading while in office and address data center-related utility costs failed Wednesday amid Democratic opposition.

item.title: DOJ accuses Minnesota federal judges of misconduct for NY Times immigration interviews
item.description: The Department of Justice seeks the recusal of the judges who spoke to The New York Times from any cases involving the Department of Homeland Security.

item.title: Inside Man: How Chinese spies used lies, love and betrayal to target the Federal Reserve
item.description: A CNBC investigation shows how former Fed advisor John Rogers became entangled with a man U.S. officials identify as a Chinese intelligence operative.

item.title: Why Jim Cramer isn't buying more Boeing despite its huge Navy contract win
item.description: Two main issues are holding him up.

item.title: Gen Z’s 'little treat’ economy is thriving. These financial products help you enjoy responsibly
item.description: Gen Z is spending on small indulgences even as finances stay tight. Here are four ways to budget for little treats more intentionally.

item.title: MGM CEO leaves door open to People Inc. bid as casino dealmaking heats up
item.description: The Wall Street Journal reported MGM was exploring an offer for People Inc. after People Inc. withdrew its $48.30-per-share proposal to buy the rest of MGM.

item.title: Watch CNBC's full interview with Citadel's Ken Griffin and Carnegie Mellon University President Farnam Jahanian
item.description: Citadel CEO Ken Griffin and Carnegie Mellon University President Farnam Jahanian join CNBC's Sara Eisen for a wide-ranging interview following the announcement Griffin donated a record-breaking $3 billion to the university.

item.title: Eli Lilly says closely watched combo obesity regimen boosts weight loss in mid-stage trial
item.description: Lilly said it plans to start Phase 3 trials on the combo regimen adding its amylin drug eloralintide to tirzepatide at the end of the year.

item.title: Trump's latest global tariffs face trade court challenge
item.description: The Trump administration says the tariffs respond to countries failing to effectively ban the trade of goods produced using forced labor practices.

item.title: Kalshi traders see high odds Anthropic's IPO is announced this year
item.description: The higher odds come after the artificial intelligence company reportedly warned investors in its IPO prospectus that its models could be dangerous.

item.title: 10-year Treasury yield is higher as traders look past inflation data, await jobs report
item.description: Treasury yields were lower on Wednesday following the release of lighter-than-expected U.S. inflation data.

item.title: Kalshi, Polymarket trading volumes on some products raise questions amid massive growth
item.description: Unusual trading patterns on Kalshi and Polymarket are drawing scrutiny as experts debate whether reported volumes reflect organic market activity.

item.title: Private sector jobs rose by 90,000 in September, better than expected, ADP reports
item.description: Private job creation picked up in September after a brief slowdown.
